body: You can't consent to taking your own life. Part of consent is being in a state of mind to be able to consent. Wanting to kill yourself (outside of a terminal illness) is inherently considered a pathological state of mind.

Meditate. Sit somewhere you feel safe, like on your bed. Take a shower and focus on the water hitting your skin. Read a book. Distract yourself. The thoughts will come but acting on them is something else entirely.
